blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Sen. Loren Legarda has officially released a comprehensive, rapid-deployment 10-Point Policy Action Plan to counter an anticipated strong to very strong El Niño. According to a statement issued on Monday, the framework calls for immediate, localized measures to protect vulnerable sectors, ensure water availability and food security, and reduce heat-related risks and other adverse impacts of El Niño. It’s a follow-up to her urgent call last September 2026 for early, science-based interventions reinforced by the filing of Senate Resolution No. 733, the Senator’s first legislative move to ensure accountability and adequate resource allocation. “What we want is a […]...
